annotations.title: Verify a number against the filing

description: Check a number you have (from a model, a news story, a spreadsheet or memory) against what the company filed. Give the company, the concept (a concept_id or fiscal alias from metrics_list, for example income_statement_total_revenues or income_statement_net_income), the period (fiscal_year plus fiscal_period, or a period string such as "FY2024", "Q4 2024" or a period end date) and the value in whole currency units; FinancialMD returns the filed value object with its proof, the delta (absolute and percent), the tolerance (half a unit at the filed precision), a scale_hint when the number would match after a power-of-ten scale (millions given as units), and a verdict: matches, differs, or unknown (company and concept exist but no fact matches the period). Optionally name the source so the audit trail records it, and as_of to verify against what was known on a date. Use it before repeating a figure that came from a model, an article or memory.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

company.description: Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

concept.description: Concept id or fiscal alias from metrics_list, for example income_statement_total_revenues, income_statement_net_income, balance_sheet_total_assets, cash_flow_free_cash_flow.

fiscal_period.description: Fiscal period label: FY, Q1 to Q4 (or H1, H2). Defaults to FY when fiscal_year is given alone.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year of the period to check (use with fiscal_period, or give period instead).

period.description: Alternative to fiscal_year and fiscal_period: "FY2024", "Q4 2024", "2024Q4", or a period end date "2024-09-28".

source.description: Optional: where your number came from, recorded in the audit trail.

value.description: The number to check, in the concept's base unit (whole currency units, not millions).

name: verify_value

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { verdict, submitted { value, source }, filed (value object with proof) or null, delta { absolute, percent } or null, tolerance, scale_hint, concept { concept_id, label } }.

anyOf.description: A proven number: value, unit, currency, decimals, period, known interval, restated, method, calc_type, proof.

proof.description: Where a value comes from: filing accession, form, filing date, taxonomy and tag, source URL, page and anchor.

inputs.description: For derived values (ratios): the proof ids of the inputs.

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Verify a number against the filing
